verdict.rationale: Fathom's own docs show it automatically produces AI-generated action items and can push them out via webhooks, so the extraction core is directly delivered. Nothing shows owners being assigned to action items, or an in-product place to collect and track them; routing them elsewhere through webhooks is a developer building block, not a tracker. missing for 10: evidence that action items carry owners/assignees, a built-in action-item tracking or collection view, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, action items with owners are automatically extracted from the conversation and collected somewhere I can track them

citations.quote: Webhooks will send your meeting data (optionally including the summary, transcript, and action items) to a URL of your choice.
At least one of `include_transcript`, `include_crm_matches`, `include_summary`, or `include_action_items` must be true.
